mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.2% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as the signal remains active whenever FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2%.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2% (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% signals deep recessionary labor market stress, triggering immediate risk-off behavior and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0.

mechanism_narrative: Joint condition of FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2% and UNRATE > 9.5% indicates aggressive policy response to severe recession, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days due to synchronized monetary and fiscal stimulus.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2 and UNRATE > 9.5.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery regime, rising HOUST signals improving consumer demand for housing, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as construction activity precedes broader economic expansion.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances during post-shock recovery when HOUST is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Positive trend in housing starts (HOUST) consistently correlates with strengthening consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances when HOUST is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 95.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days due to heightened recession fears.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: Joint condition of rising HOUST and FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2% amplifies consumer demand recovery, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through synchronized monetary and demand stimulus.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances when HOUST is rising and FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2.

mechanism_narrative: In recessionary labor market regime, PAYEMS below 131,000 thousand persons signals severe employment contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days due to policy response expectations.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances when PAYEMS < 131000 in recessionary labor market.
